fix_plan.description: Minimal surgical fix for TypeError: Object of type UUID is not JSON serializable in audit logging

files_to_modify.rationale: json.dumps lacks default=str handler for native UUID objects

fix_plan.patch:
--- a/app/services/audit_service.py
+++ b/app/services/audit_service.py
@@ -13,5 +13,5 @@
 def format_audit_log(event_payload: Dict[str, Any]) -> str:
     """Format audit event into serialized JSON log string."""
-    return json.dumps(event_payload)
+    return json.dumps(event_payload, default=str)
fix_plan.rationale: json.dumps lacks default=str handler for native UUID objects
